cards.audioText: Your call sign is UAL805, a flight to Guangzhou. You are approaching WXI at 11000m. You are squawking 6527. Contact Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是美联航805，是一架飞往广州的航班。你现在接近WXI，高度11000米，你的应答机编码是6527。联系郑州区调。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL805, approaching WXI at 11000m, squawk 6527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航805，接近WXI，高度11000米，应答机编码6527。

cards.audioText: UAL805, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, offset 3 miles to the right, reduce to Mach .75, due to Wuhan Control restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航805，郑州区调，雷达识别了，右偏置3海里，由于武汉区调限制，速度减小至马赫数点75。
cards.referenceText:
Roger, offset 3 miles to the right, reduce to Mach .75, UAL805.、
（注：题干中due to Wuhan Control restrictions属于情报，无需复诵，或用roger代替）
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，右偏置3海里，速度减小至马赫数点75，美联航805。

cards.audioText: There is adverse weather ahead, request Zhengzhou Control for 20 miles deviation right of track and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: 前方有恶劣天气，向郑州区调请求右偏航20海里，并陈述原因。
cards.referenceText:
Zhengzhou Control, UAL805, request 20 miles deviation right of track due weather.
（注：题干明确要求state the reason，因此，答案中的due weather不可省略）
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航805，由于天气，请求右偏航20海里。

cards.audioText: UAL805, 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航805，同意右偏航20海里，脱离天气后报。
cards.referenceText:
20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather, (wilco), UAL805.
（注：题干中的report when clear of weather，可用wilco回复）
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意右偏航20海里，脱离天气后报(或“照办”)，美联航805。

cards.audioText: Now tell the controller you are clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在告诉管制员你已经脱离天气了。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL805, clear of weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航805，脱离天气了。

cards.audioText:
UAL805, the restriction still exists, reduce speed to Mach .72.
Advise Zhengzhou Control Mach .72 is not acceptable which is too slow for your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航805，依旧存在限制，速度降至马赫数点72。
告诉郑州区调，不能接受马赫数点72，对你的飞机来说，太慢了。
cards.referenceText:
Negative, unable Mach.72 because it's too slow for us, UAL805.
（注：一般用Negative, unable ...来表达“不能，无法执行”这一含义，并陈述原因）
cards.referenceTextZh: 不能马赫数点72，这对我们来说太慢了，美联航805。

cards.audioText: UAL805, Zhengzhou Control, maintain Mach .75, we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Zhengzhou control area due to Zhengzhou radar failure.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航805，郑州区调，保持马赫数点75，由于郑州雷达失效，我们现在正在限制飞进郑州管制区域的航空器。
cards.referenceText:
Maintain Mach .75, UAL805.
（注：we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Zhengzhou control area due to Zhengzhou radar failure属于情报，无需复诵）

cards.audioText:
UAL805, what is your estimated time for OBLIK?
Inform Zhengzhou Control your estimated time for OBLIK is 0638Z.
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航805，你预计到达OBLIK的时间是多少？
告诉郑州区调，你预计到达OBLIK的时间是0638Z。

cards.audioText: UAL805, make a right orbit due spacing, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646Z.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航805，由于间距，右盘旋一圈，到达OBLIK的时间不早于0646Z。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646Z. UAL805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右盘旋一圈，到达OBLIK的时间不早于0646Z，美联航805。

cards.audioText: You have completed the orbit, request track direct to OBLIK.
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL805, request track to OBLIK.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航805，请求直飞OBLIK。

cards.audioText: UAL805, negative direct to OBLIK, turn left heading 130 to intercept A461 airway.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航805，不能直飞OBLIK，左转航向130，切A461航路。
cards.referenceText: Roger, turn left heading 130 to intercept A461 airway, UAL805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，左转航向130，切A461航路，美联航805。
